examples.scenario: Credential harvesting via spear-phishing email impersonating Microsoft 365 admin alert with URL obfuscation

technical_data.email_body:
Subject: Immediate Action Required: Microsoft 365 Security Alert From: Microsoft 365 Admin To: user@example.com MIME-Version: 1.0 Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8

Dear User,

We detected suspicious activity on your Microsoft 365 account. Please click here immediately to verify your credentials and secure your account.

Failure to do so may result in account suspension.

Thank you,
Microsoft 365 Security Team

indicators: Domain 'verify-accounts.com' newly registered (2024-04-28) and used in phishing URL
Email from 'alerts@micros0ft-support.com' with domain spoofing (note 'micros0ft' with zero)
URL obfuscation by subdomain chaining to mimic legitimate Microsoft URLs
SMTP source IP 198.51.100.23 with no DKIM signature and DMARC fail
Web server IP 198.51.100.45 responding to phishing credential submission
examples.detection_method: Use email security gateways with domain spoofing and URL reputation checks to block messages from newly registered domains and suspicious subdomain chains. Monitor DMARC failures and absence of DKIM. Employ sandbox detonation to detect credential submission behavior on URLs. User training to spot domain misspellings and suspicious links.

examples.detection_method: Email gateways blocking SPF-failing mails and scanning for embedded HTML forms with credential fields. Web proxy logs monitoring POST requests to suspicious domains. Domain age and WHOIS lookups correlated with email sender domains. User training to avoid submitting credentials in email-embedded forms.

examples.scenario: Credential harvesting via phishing email with URL encoded and homoglyph obfuscated link mimicking Salesforce login portal

technical_data.email_body:
Subject: [Action Required] Salesforce Account Security Update From: Salesforce Security To: user@corporate.net MIME-Version: 1.0 Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8

Dear User,

We detected unauthorized login attempts to your Salesforce account. Please verify your identity by clicking the link below:

https://salesforcе-secure.com/login

Failure to verify may result in temporary suspension.

Regards,
Salesforce Security Team
technical_data.note: The character 'е' in 'salesforcе-secure.com' is a Cyrillic small letter ie (U+0435), visually similar to Latin 'e' (U+0065).

indicators: Use of homoglyph (Cyrillic 'е') in domain to spoof 'salesforce-secure.com'
Domain registered recently and linked to credential phishing
Email fails SPF and shows neutral authentication results
Phishing URL encoded redirect parameter to mimic legitimate navigation
HTTP POST requests with credentials to suspicious domain
examples.detection_method: Implement visual similarity detection (IDN homograph checks) in email filtering and web proxies. Monitor for newly registered domains with brand names and suspicious character sets. Analyze HTTP POST requests to external domains with credential field names. User awareness training on homoglyph phishing.
